blocks.text: Allergies is wajah se hoti hain ke immune system un kamzor antigens ke liye hadd se zyada hassas (hypersensitive) ho jata hai jin se aksar logon mein koi immune response nahin hota. Allergy paida karne wale maadde allergens kehlate hain, maslan gard (dust), phaphoond (molds), phoolon ka zar (pollen), billi ki jild ke zarre (cat dander), kuch khane aur kuch dawaen (jaise penicillin).

Allergen ka saamna hone ke baad kuch log aik qism ki antibody banate hain jise E-antibodies kehte hain. Yeh antibodies mast cells se jur jati hain (mast cells aam taur par khoon ki naliyon ke gird connective tissue mein hote hain). Mast cells histamines chhorte hain jo inflammatory response shuru karti hain. Is se khoon ki naliyan phail jati hain, maya bahar risne lagta hai, aur doosri tabdeeliyan hoti hain jaise chheenkein, naak behna, kharish waghaira. Kuch logon mein histamines jaan lewa anaphylactic shock paida kar sakti hain, jis mein soojan ki wajah se saans lena mushkil ho jata hai. Aam allergies ke ilaaj mein antihistamine dawaen shamil hain jo histamines ko rok kar waqti aaraam deti hain. Bohat si allergies ka ilaaj mareezon ko antigens ke extracts (arq) ke teeke laga kar bhi kiya jata hai. Is ilaaj ko desensitization kehte hain. Is tareeqe se khoon mein G-antibodies banti hain. Jab allergen jism mein aata hai to E-antibodies tak pohanchne se pehle hi G-antibodies use khatam kar deti hain.

blocks.alt: Aik qataar: allergen B-cell se jurta, jo plasma cell ban kar E-antibodies chhorta; E-antibodies apne tane se mast cell par jurti; jab allergen in se jurta to mast cell histamines chhorta jo alamaat (symptoms) paida karti hain.

blocks.text: Allergen B-cell se milta hai; B-cell plasma cell ban kar E-antibodies banata hai; E-antibodies mast cell par lag jati hain; dobara allergen aane par mast cell histamines chhorta hai, aur histamines alamaat (symptoms) paida karti hain.
